sample.title: Why It's So Expensive To Run An Auto Repair Shop
sample.description:
Auto repair prices have risen far faster than overall inflation. Mechanics say one key reason is the new software, parts, and safety technology. Shops are spending more on software access and safety calibration equipment. While the number of auto repair shops has grown, some who work in the business say it is getting harder to keep up, especially for smaller ones.

sample.title: Inside Man: How Chinese Spies Used Lies, Romance And Betrayal To Target The Federal Reserve
sample.description:
One week after a friendly summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump, CNBC details an aggressive plot by China to infiltrate one of the United States’ most important institutions: the Federal Reserve. This explosive documentary delves into the incredible saga of a Chinese spy's effort to obtain secrets from the inner confines of the U.S.' top bank. It's a tale of sex, money, deceit and betrayal that put some of the country’s vital economic and financial secrets at risk. With exclusive access to new documents, audio, photos and text messages, CNBC's Senior Washington Correspondent Eamon Javers uncovers the story of former Fed economist John Rogers and a Chinese spy posing as an economics student who he befriended in 2013. “Inside Man” is a spy story at the heart of the competition for global economic dominance, posing the question of whether Rogers was a spy himself or an unwitting dupe.

sample.title: Why AMD is benefiting from the new wave of AI agents
sample.description: The early years of the AI boom were dominated by Nvidia, with its graphics processing units that excel at training and running large models by the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic. But nearly four years after the launch of ChatGPT, users have embraced new agentic apps like Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots, and chip rival AMD has found a massive growth opportunity. Agents are run primarily off of virtual machines, powered by the central processor, where AMD, Intel and others have a lead over Nvidia.
